song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: Bondage and release, both from the Lord's own nature, never part;
in truth, in the Lord, there is no split.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare

verses.craft: Double non-difference kept double (never-part + no-split; emphasis-not-redundancy per UNC).
verses.rejected: (a) trimming one half → killed: double is doctrine. (b) in-truth→truly → killed: satya-word weight.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śānta-vīra of non-difference / L2+L3 voice
